why: I checked every command in both briefs. The builder's `npm test` works, since package.json defines `node --test`. Verifier checks 1, 2 and 4 are valid JavaScript inside double quotes and only use math.js and README.md, which exist. Check 3 breaks. Its regex pieces `'^#+\\s*'+n+'\\s*\\('` sit inside a double-quoted bash string, and bash turns each `\\` into `\`. JavaScript then reads the string literals `'\s*'` and `'\('`, and those unnecessary escapes collapse to `s*` and `(`. So the pattern becomes `^#+s*adds*(`, which has an unclosed `(`. `new RegExp` throws "SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression … Unterminated group", so the command crashes even when README.md is correct. That means at least one command does not run as written.
